transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thanks for taking the time to see me. I, uh... I hope it's alright that I'm here. 

I guess I'm here because... well, everybody keeps acting like I'm just imagining things, and I really don't want to cause any trouble for anyone, you know? But... I know my wife's relative has been coming into our house to get at me. I mean, I work with my hands, I know exactly where I leave my tools, and they just don't move themselves. And it seems like every single weekend, my fishing plans get completely spoiled, and it's not just bad luck. 

I don't want to sound unreasonable or anything—I really hope you don't think I'm making a big fuss over nothing—but after all these months, I can see plain as day that he's been trying to take over my place and, well, push me out. Does that make sense? I just want to get things sorted out, the right way.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when there was no one around to make them?

Oh, no, doctor. No, nothing like that. I really hope you don't think I'm... well, you know, losing my mind or anything like that. I definitely don't hear voices or any strange sounds. Just the normal sounds of the house, or the shop when I'm working. 

I'm completely level-headed about all this, I promise you. I only know what I see with my own eyes when my things are messed with. Is that... is that what you were checking for? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information, so we can figure this out.
Have you noticed feeling this kind of suspicion toward other people in your life, or is it just with your wife's relative?

Oh, no. No, definitely not. I... I really try to get along with everybody. The guys at the shop, the neighbors... we're all good. I don't want you to think I'm just going around pointing fingers at people, because I'm really not like that. I'm a pretty easy-going guy, honestly. 

It's... it's really just him. Just my wife's relative. If it wasn't for the things happening right in front of me with my tools and my fishing gear, I wouldn't even be saying a bad word about him, either. I hate to even complain at all, to be honest. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm not coming across as, you know, a difficult person or a troublemaker, because I really don't have a problem with anyone else in the world. I hope that's okay to say.
Have you had any significant medical illnesses, head injuries, or neurological conditions around the time this started?

No, nothing like that at all. I mean, I'm pretty healthy, thankfully. I haven't been in the hospital or bumped my head or... or had anything wrong with my brain, if that's what you mean. 

I really try to take good care of myself, you know? I don't want to be a burden on anyone. So, physically, I'm doing just fine. I hope that's helpful... I just want to make sure I'm giving you the answers you need. Is that what you were looking for?
